title.zh: 加密早报：Abstract 宣布分阶段关停，Coinbase 计划年底前重新推出 Coinbase Pro
title.en: Crypto Morning Briefing: Abstract Announces Phased Shutdown, Coinbase Plans to Relaunch Coinbase Pro by Year-End

current_state.zh: 每日加密简报中的 Abstract 分阶段关闭事件现已明确：Abstract 将于 2026 年 12 月 15 日关闭，各迁移路径的截止时间可能更早；Coinbase 计划年底前重启 Coinbase Pro 仍按此前报道。
current_state.en: The Abstract phased shutdown covered in the daily crypto briefing is now more specific: Abstract will shut down on Dec. 15, 2026, with route-specific migration cutoffs potentially earlier; Coinbase's planned Coinbase Pro relaunch by year-end remains as previously reported.

updates.title_zh: 加密早报：Abstract 宣布分阶段关停，Coinbase 计划年底前重新推出 Coinbase Pro
updates.title_en: Crypto Morning Briefing: Abstract Announces Phased Shutdown, Coinbase Plans to Relaunch Coinbase Pro by Year-End
updates.what_changed_zh: 一份每日加密简报称，Abstract 已宣布分阶段关停，而 Coinbase 打算在年底前重新推出 Coinbase Pro。
updates.what_changed_en: A daily crypto briefing reports that Abstract has announced a phased shutdown while Coinbase intends to relaunch Coinbase Pro by the end of the year.
updates.current_state_zh: 一份每日加密简报称，Abstract 已宣布分阶段关停，而 Coinbase 打算在年底前重新推出 Coinbase Pro。
updates.current_state_en: A daily crypto briefing reports that Abstract has announced a phased shutdown while Coinbase intends to relaunch Coinbase Pro by the end of the year.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: A daily crypto briefing reports that Abstract has announced a phased shutdown while Coinbase intends to relaunch Coinbase Pro by the end of the year.
updates.detailed_summary_en: A daily crypto briefing reports that Abstract has announced a phased shutdown while Coinbase intends to relaunch Coinbase Pro by the end of the year.

updates.title_zh: Abstract 的关停暴露了拥有资产与能够转移资产之间的差距
updates.title_en: Abstract’s shutdown exposes the gap between owning assets and being able to move them
updates.what_changed_zh: 后续报道补充了 Abstract 关闭的具体日期为 2026 年 12 月 15 日，并说明各迁移路径的启动、完成和申领截止时间可能更早；Cube 条款还明确了迁移与资产访问的相关条件。
updates.what_changed_en: Follow-up coverage adds that Abstract's shutdown date is Dec. 15, 2026, with route-specific initiation, completion, and claim cutoffs potentially earlier; Cube terms also clarify migration and asset-access conditions.
updates.current_state_zh: 每日加密简报中的 Abstract 分阶段关闭事件现已明确：Abstract 将于 2026 年 12 月 15 日关闭，各迁移路径的截止时间可能更早；Coinbase 计划年底前重启 Coinbase Pro 仍按此前报道。
updates.current_state_en: The Abstract phased shutdown covered in the daily crypto briefing is now more specific: Abstract will shut down on Dec. 15, 2026, with route-specific migration cutoffs potentially earlier; Coinbase's planned Coinbase Pro relaunch by year-end remains as previously reported.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ethereum layer-2 network Abstract will shut down on Dec. 15, 2026, forcing users to migrate assets before route-specific cutoffs or lose practical access to funds even though they technically retain ownership.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ethereum layer-2 network Abstract will shut down on Dec. 15, 2026, forcing users to migrate assets before route-specific cutoffs or lose practical access to funds even though they technically retain ownership.
